title: DocumentRecipient
description: A recipient assigned to a document who may be required to sign, approve, or receive a copy of the document.

id.description: Unique identifier of the recipient within the document.

role.description: Role name that maps the recipient to fields in the document.

signing_order.description: Order in which this recipient must sign relative to other recipients. Null if no signing order is enforced.

has_completed.description: Whether this recipient has completed all required actions.

contact_id.description: Identifier of the associated contact record if linked.

shared_link.description: Public signing link for this recipient.
